description: Run a BMAD Epic autonomously to a deterministic, TEA-gated Definition-of-Done: preflight to a remediated green light, define done as executable tests, advance only on a machine-checked gate verdict.
args: {<epic>: target epic id}|{--light: trace gate only}|{--parallel: experimental worktree fan-out}|{-H: headless}|{--yes: skip open-floor invite + launch confirm}|{--retro: close-out retrospective}|{--max-stories N: bound this invocation to N stories then finalize normally}|{setup: register or re-register the module (configure and register are aliases)}

description: Run the standalone formalize readiness gate over an Epic's planning artifacts: auto-remediate machine-derivable gaps, route JUDGMENT candidates to one throwaway subagent, and adapt the ready/remediable/blocked verdict into the canonical five-key headless envelope.
args: {-H: headless five-key JSON envelope}|{<epic>: target epic id}

description: Read-only status view over a run, rendered from the files it already wrote: the heartbeat snapshot, the decision-log tail, the deferred-work ledger, the escalation sidecars, and an index of known run folders. Launches nothing, attaches to nothing, writes nothing.
args: {--run-dir: a specific run folder}|{--runs-root: the runs root}

description: Decide-surface for a blocked or escalated run: reconstruct every pending decision from the typed escalation sidecars, the single preflight RED sidecar and the deferred-work ledger, walk them in one guided pass, record each answer, and hand control back to the existing resume.
